original_test_intent: Verify that the exact approved Mellanox CX9 board and its defined board-side connections can be safely serviced and reseated, remain mechanically sound, and return with the same FRU identity, PCIe/NIC enumeration and qualified link state without new errors.
original_method: Identify CX9 PN/serial/revision, slot, retention hardware and every board-side connector/cable; capture photos, PCIe/NIC identity/link and errors; power down and isolate exactly as the vendor procedure requires; a qualified ESD-protected operator inspects and performs one approved board/relevant connector reseat without judging insertion force by trial; restore hardware/power and prove the identical board, endpoint, link and management state return with no damage or new fault.
manual_activity: A qualified hardware technician physically inspects and performs the single authorized CX9 board/connector service action under approved power, ESD and retention controls.
required_inputs: CX9 PN/serial/revision, approved slot and populated configuration
Vendor service drawing, retention/torque, ESD and exact power-isolation procedure
Board-side connector/cable action list and prohibited live-service scope
Expected PCIe BDF/device IDs, firmware/driver, lane generation/width, NIC identity and error limits
safety_requirements: Do not treat subjective ease of insertion as permission to force or cycle a connector
De-energize and discharge per the CX9/platform procedure before board handling
Photograph and label every affected connector/cable before removal and preserve logs
Stop on damage, resistance, mismatch, power fault, missing board, link downgrade or new PCIe/NIC error
No repeated reseat or automatic recovery attempt
agent_execution_scope: Validate CX9 identity, service scope, power/ESD controls and expected detection oracle
Collect immutable pre/post inventory, link/error outputs and operator-supplied photos
Correlate timestamps and discrepancies without judging tactile or physical condition
Do not touch hardware, authorize live service, clear logs, reuse BF4-cable evidence or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the exact CX9 FRU, slot, board-side connection and one service cycle
Approve power/ESD/retention procedure, detection/link/error criteria and recovery
Review physical and electronic evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The physical CX9 board inspection/reseat cannot be replaced by SSH; software commands only verify identity, PCIe/NIC state and errors after technician work.

command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The single plug-cycle/detection goal and 5/5-minute allocation remain; force, repeated cycling and undefined components are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH MANUAL CX9 BOARD MECHANICAL SERVICE AND POST-CYCLE DETECTION TEST
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform one traceable CX9 board-specific service action under vendor controls and prove both mechanical restoration and the same electronic identity/link state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines the board boundary, FRU/slot/connector map, safe power state, objective electronic oracle and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: BF4 cable evidence or generic seating photos cannot prove the CX9 board retention, connector state or PCIe/NIC recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Incorrect handling can damage high-density connectors, disturb neighboring cables, cause ESD damage, lose the endpoint or degrade its link.

project_override_considerations: AVL qualification must name the installed CX9 PN/revision and permitted equivalents. A device merely appearing is insufficient if FRU identity, link width/speed, NIC ports or error state differ.

Vendor procedure, power/ESD/retention controls and labeled board-connector map
Unique pre/during/post photos showing retention, connectors, pins, cables and seals
Pre/post PCIe BDF/device/link/AER plus NIC port, firmware, driver and health evidence
Preserved SEL/kernel/boot logs and technician action timestamps

review_improvement: Turns a subjective generic plug check into a CX9-board-specific traceable service action with mechanical and electronic restoration evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The item names the entire CX9 board, while the procedure says all components. A safe review must prevent that ambiguity from authorizing arbitrary cable or board cycling. The exact FRU, retention and board-side connection scope must be frozen first. Seating is demonstrated by inspected hardware plus unchanged PCIe/NIC identity and qualified link/error state; detectability alone can conceal lane downgrade, port loss or a misidentified replacement.
